identified_as: North York Borough High School, North York (York County)
notes: One team reference; class colours (navy/white, green/white) ignored.
evidence: North York Panther yearbook 1953 OCR: "A hard-fighting Orange and Black squad of North York High booters".

era: Manor Township HS -> Manor-Millersville HS (1932) -> Penn Manor HS (blue and gold, Comets).
notes: Same school under its own 1940s name; colours match later Penn Manor.
evidence: 1946 Trumpeter yearbook of "Manor High School, Millersville" OCR: alma mater "Manor, you're our Alma Mater ... May we ever bear the mem'ry ... of our gold and blue".

identified_as: Osceola Mills High School, Osceola Mills (Clearfield County)
era: Later merged into Philipsburg-Osceola (navy and white).
notes: School-level colours stated on the 1949 school page (separate from that year's class colours violet/white); class colours (scarlet/gray, navy/silver, maroon/gray etc.) ignored. Text only, no hex.
evidence: 1949 Osceolian OCR, school page: "The Osceola High School ... MOTTO: This One Thing I Do / COLORS: Blue and White / THE CREED I believe in the Osceola High School..." (1949 class colours listed separately as violet and white); 1950: seniors "clad in blue and white gowns". Mascot "Indians" from Tyrone article.

era: Burnham HS and Derry Township HS (Yeagertown) shared a supervising principal by 1951 ('Burnham & Derry Schools'); later folded into the Lewistown-area / Mifflin County system (now Mifflin County HS, purple/black/silver).
notes: Retry: still no source for the joint Burnham-Derry school's own colours; predecessors differ (Burnham blue/white, Derry crimson), so none assigned.
evidence: No Burnham-Derry yearbook online. Predecessor Burnham HS (Burgoblac yearbook 1950) teams "blue and white clads", "playing for the Blue and White"; Derry Township HS (Yeagertown) was Red Devils/crimson. Retry: Burnham 1927/28/50/51 books scanned; 1951 lists "Supervising Principal Burnham & Derry Schools" but Burnham and Derry still separate high schools (played each other in football). No joint-school colours found.

identified_as: North Huntingdon Township High School (Westmoreland County)
era: Merged with Irwin into Norwin (blue and gold) in 1958; final North Huntingdon class 1958.
notes: Two yearbook years agree; text only, no hex.
evidence: North Huntingdon Norhiscope yearbook OCR: 1954 "the Blue and Gold grapplers", "Bulldog matmen", "victorious over the Blue and Gold"; 1958 majorettes "blue and gold jackets", cheerleaders "gold and blue uniforms".

era: McVeytown-Oliver HS renamed Bratton-McVeytown-Oliver 1950, Rothrock HS 1956; closed 1978 (later Lewistown Area / Mifflin County).
notes: Evidence is from 1951 onward (same school after renaming); pre-1950 McVeytown-Oliver colours not seen directly.
evidence: Successor-by-renaming Bratton-McVeytown-Oliver HS (Le Livre yearbook 1951) OCR: yearbook section "the Blue and Gold"; alma mater "All hail! Alma Mater, Our own Gold and Blue"; same alma mater in 1958 Rothrock HS book, cheerleaders "Blue and Gold clad".

era: Scott Township became part of Chartiers Valley SD (formed 1956; red and blue Colts).
notes: Identity: e-yearbook lists Scott Township HS (Carnegie), Allegheny County, matching. Yearbooks 1939-46; later mascot unknown (1956 book titled Rocket).
evidence: Scott Township HS (Carnegie) Scottie yearbook OCR: 1939 "starred for the Blue and Gold warriors", "the Blue and Gold cagers", cheerleaders "decked in blue and white, wearing gold letters"; 1946 alma mater-style song "a blue and golden hue".

era: Merged with North Huntingdon into Norwin (blue and gold) in 1958.
notes: Own-era yearbooks, several years agree on blue and gold; scarlet and gray appears as the junior-high colours. Same colours as successor Norwin, but attested from Irwin's own books.
evidence: Irwin Carillon yearbook OCR: 1950 band "blue and gold banner"; 1953 "Let's Go Knights ... cheerleaders dressed in gold and blue"; 1957 varsity cheerleaders "navy and gold", junior-high squad "abandoning their scarlet and gray for Varsity colors, gold and blue". 1956 basketball calls a team "the scarlet and grey" (ambiguous, likely junior-high or opponent).

era: Merged with Roaring Spring HS and Martinsburg HS into Central HS, Spring Cove SD (1960; red and gray Dragons).
notes: Alma mater names the colours outright.
evidence: Morrison Cove Pine Crest yearbook OCR: 1953 alma mater "Hail to old Cove High ... Hail to her colors, Loyal white and blue"; cheerleaders "in blue and white uniforms" (1953, 1955).
